translations.EN: Heads up. Something's wrong out there.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat. May mali sa labas.

translations.EN: Look alive. The situation outside is shifting.
translations.TL: Maging alerto. Nagbabago ang sitwasyon sa labas.

translations.EN: Pay attention. We have unexpected movement outside.
translations.TL: Makinig ka. May di-inaasahang galaw sa labas.

translations.EN: Warning. Something big is happening nearby.
translations.TL: Babala. May malaking nangyayari sa malapit.

translations.EN: Heads up, everyone. Check your gear.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat ang lahat. Suriin ang mga gamit niyo.

translations.EN: Listen close. An event is unfolding out there.
translations.TL: Makinig nang mabuti. May kaganapan sa labas.

translations.EN: Alert. We need to be ready for trouble.
translations.TL: Alerto. Kailangan nating maging handa sa gulo.

translations.EN: Keep your eyes open. That sound wasn't normal.
translations.TL: Buksan ang mga mata. Hindi karaniwan ang tunog na 'yon.

translations.EN: Stay sharp. The perimeter is showing activity.
translations.TL: Maging alerto. May aktibidad sa paligid.

translations.EN: Heads up. Let's not get caught unprepared.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat. Huwag tayong mahuling walang paghahanda.

translations.EN: Stay close. Something's wrong out there.
translations.TL: Manatili kang malapit. May mali sa labas.

translations.EN: Stick by me, friend. We have trouble brewing outside.
translations.TL: Dumikit ka sa akin, kaibigan. May namumuong gulo sa labas.

translations.EN: Don't wander off. Something bad is moving out there.
translations.TL: Huwag kang lalayo. May masamang gumagalaw sa labas.

translations.EN: Keep close and stay low. I'll protect you.
translations.TL: Manatiling malapit at yumuko. Poprotektahan kita.

translations.EN: Hey, stay behind me until we know what that was.
translations.TL: Huy, manatili ka sa likod ko hanggang malaman natin 'yon.

translations.EN: Careful, everyone! Let's look out for one another.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat ang lahat! Magbantayan tayo sa isa't isa.

translations.EN: Hold on to each other. Danger is nearby.
translations.TL: Kumapit sa isa't isa. Malapit lang ang panganib.

translations.EN: Stay safe by my side. Trouble is coming.
translations.TL: Manatiling ligtas sa tabi ko. Parating ang panganib.

translations.EN: Heads up, partner. Whatever happens, we stick together.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat, kasama. Anuman ang mangyari, sama-sama tayo.

translations.EN: Keep close. I don't want anyone getting separated.
translations.TL: Dumikit ka. Ayokong may mahiwalay sa atin.

translations.EN: Heads up!
translations.TL: Mag-ingat!

translations.EN: Incoming!
translations.TL: Paparating!

translations.EN: Danger!
translations.TL: Panganib!

translations.EN: Look out!
translations.TL: Mag-ingat ka!

translations.EN: Alert!
translations.TL: Alerto!

translations.EN: Listen!
translations.TL: Makinig!

translations.EN: Trouble!
translations.TL: Gulo!

translations.EN: Ready weapons!
translations.TL: Ihanda ang armas!

translations.EN: Movement!
translations.TL: May gumagalaw!

translations.EN: Cover!
translations.TL: Magtago!

translations.EN: Stay sharp. We've got trouble.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat ka. May problema tayo.

translations.EN: Weapons drawn, now. Danger outside.
translations.TL: Ibunot ang armas, ngayon na. May panganib sa labas.

translations.EN: Shut up and listen. Something is coming.
translations.TL: Tumahimik at makinig. May paparating.

translations.EN: Lock the doors and watch every angle.
translations.TL: Ikandado ang pinto at bantayan ang bawat sulok.

translations.EN: If it moves through that entrance, put it down.
translations.TL: Kapag may gumalaw sa lagusang 'yan, patumbahin mo.

translations.EN: Trouble's coming. Don't freeze up on me.
translations.TL: Parating ang gulo. Huwag kang tatanga-tanga.

translations.EN: Get into defensive positions immediately.
translations.TL: Pumwesto sa depensa agad-agad.

translations.EN: Keep quiet. You don't want to draw them here.
translations.TL: Manahimik ka. Ayaw mong maakit sila rito.

translations.EN: Threat incoming. Expect the worst.
translations.TL: Banta parating. Asahan ang pinakamasama.

translations.EN: Eyes on the perimeter. Shoot on sight.
translations.TL: Bantayan ang paligid. Barilin agad kapag nakita.
